newsitem.title: CHINA: China invests 22.3 bln yun in key projects in Q1.
newsitem.headline: China invests 22.3 bln yun in key projects in Q1.

text.p: Investment in 129 key China projects in the first quarter reached 22.3 billion yuan ($2.68 billion), unchanged from the level in the year-ago period, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The amount accounted for 14.4 percent of the state plan for the year, it said, quoting the State Statistical Bureau.
Total investment in the projects this year was estimated to reach 154.7 billion yuan, a rise of 13.4 billion yuan compared with last year, it said.

Of the total, 79.8 billion yuan was for energy projects, or 51.5 percent of the total investment, while 35.5 billion yuan was for communication projects, 23.3 billion yuan for key raw materials projects, and 9.0 billion yuan for agricultural, forest and waterpower projects, it said.
